cause_quote: The added `await directory.mkdir(path.relative(ancestor, canonicalSource));` created protected skill directories in the workspace projection after its baseline had been captured, and layout preparation returned without checkpointing them.
user_saw: A guest preparing an owned PR from a fresh conversation was told the workspace contained unsaved work before any PR source was applied.
summary: The fix checkpoints the managed workspace when sandbox setup creates protected skill directories, allowing the initial PR import to pass the clean-workspace check.
reasoning: The parent of #182412 already had the initial PR import and a test covering successful import into an empty workspace, and its mount resolver only selected directories that already existed. #182412 added directory creation after baseline capture, so the existing manifest comparison rejected the fresh projection because it contained `.agents`, `.agents/skills`, and `skills` while the canonical workspace was empty.
